body.name: Moreau--Kastler proportional-target specialization
body.construction: \(\theta(\eta)=\{\sum_{(g,t)\in\mathcal D}w^0_{gt}v_{gt}\}/\{\sum_{(g,t)\in\mathcal D}w^0_{gt}\}-1=\sum_{(g,t)\in\mathcal D}\{w^0_{gt}/B(\eta)\}(v_{gt}-1)\), the aggregate product-Poisson specialization of Moreau--Kastler (2025), equation (3.14).
